setup_legend.setups: 'setup' is the stage the piece is first worn in. Stash pieces were read from the overlay's shared-stash view on 2026-11-19.
setup_legend.lvl 40-60 (Nightmare: Grizzly to 20, Mig: Grizzly to 20 by 51 (+10% damage to every wolf and the bear per point). Hire the Nightmare Act 2 Might merc. Jalal's Mane, Raven Frost and String of Ears are worn now and stay on after the Fury respec. Smoke is merc gear (the merc's armor); the druid keeps Stealth for its Faster Cast Rate.
setup_legend.lvl 60-75 (Hell: Spirit Wolf 20, Heart o: Spirit Wolf to 20 by 60 (with the Hell Den of Evil point) (+25% attack rating for Dire Wolves and the Grizzly per point), then Heart of Wolverine to 20 by 75 (+7% damage and +7% attack rating per point for you, the merc and every pet: +153% damage, +158% attack rating at 20). From 75 with the switch gear (Cannot Be Frozen item, powerful weapon, Harmony, 2x Lawbringer for the merc, Smoke, life-leech merc helm) the Fury switch is possible (optional).
setup_legend.lvl 75-99 (Hell endgame: Ravens to 20): Without the switch the summoner goes on to 99: Ravens 20 by 90, then only the last 9 reserve points go to Arctic Blast 1 (prerequisite) and Cyclone Armor 8 (absorbs 124 fire/cold/lightning damage per cast). Endgame summoner gear: Heart of the Oak, Jalal's Mane, Enigma, Mara's Kaleidoscope, Arachnid Mesh.
setup_legend.alternative: The Maxroll Summon Druid guide's Gear Options (user, 2026-11-22: "did you do it for the summoner druid too?"): its unique/set/runeword pieces of every slot after this build's own stage pieces, one-handed weapons and shields included (the summoner fights with sword and shield), the weapon-swap list, both ring slots (ring2 lists the same rings) and its unique charms in the extras; no rare, crafted, magic or plain socketed entries (no build-file form). Merc (user: "can we get that for the mercs too"): the guide's Act 2 Might merc pieces (The Reaper's Toll, Hustle, Fortitude, Treachery, Guillaume's Face) after Insight, Smoke and Bulwark. One copy each is wanted.

stat_source: All numbers are computed from the D2R game tables (blizzhackers/d2data JSON, current with the Warlock class): skill requirements, petmax/HP/damage/synergy formulas from skills.json and skilldesc.json, runeword runes/types/levels from runes.json + misc.json (rune levelreq), base requirements and socket limits from weapons.json/armor.json/itemtypes.json, unique/set stats from uniqueitems.json/setitems.json, merc auras from hireling.json. Not from a build guide.

targets.skill_points: 1 per level from level 2 plus quests: Den of Evil +1, Radament +1, Izual +2 per difficulty (12 in total). Level 40 = 39 + 4 (Normal) + 1 (Nightmare Den) = 44; level 75 = 74 + 12 = 86; level 99 = 98 + 12 = 110.
targets.summons: From skills.json: Raven count min(lvl,5), 12+lvl-1 hits, damage +12% per Spirit/Dire Wolf/Grizzly base level. Spirit Wolf count min(lvl,5), its points give Dire Wolves and the Grizzly +25% attack rating and +10% defense each. Dire Wolf count min(lvl,3), damage 7-12 (lvl 1) / 15-24 (5) / 37-53 (12) / 85-109 (20), HP +60% at 1 to +535% at 20, and each Dire Wolf point gives Spirit Wolves and the Grizzly +15% life. Grizzly 30-60 base, its points give Spirit Wolves, Dire Wolves and itself +25% damage +10% per level. Spirit Wolves and Dire Wolves are separate pet types, so 5 + 3 + bear + 5 ravens fight together. Pet level is the character level (calc2 ulvl), so the summons keep up without points; points add the synergies above.
targets.survival: Heart of Wolverine is the spirit that is out: +20% damage +7%/level and +25% attack rating +7%/level for you, the merc and the pets (Wolverine Aura); 20 points by 75 = +153% damage, +158% attack rating. It is maxed after Grizzly 20 and Spirit Wolf 20 (a Grizzly point gives the wolves and the bear +10% damage, more than Wolverine's +7%; a Spirit Wolf point +25% attack rating). Oak Sage stays at 1 point (prerequisite; +30% life if cast instead, only one spirit is out at a time). Cyclone Armor only with the last reserve points (8 points from 92, after Arctic Blast 1): absorbs 40 + 12/level fire, cold and lightning damage per cast (124 at level 8), recast as it wears off.
targets.respec: optional, from 75 (Akara's free reset of any difficulty whose Den of Evil reward is still unused; stat points are refunded too): Fury 20, Werewolf 20, Feral Rage 20, Lycanthropy 20 (460 s form), Rabies 1, Oak Sage 5 = 86 points. Only once the switch gear (Cannot Be Frozen item, powerful weapon, Harmony, 2x Lawbringer for the merc, Smoke, life-leech merc helm) is owned; without it the summoner goes on to 99. Details in the Fury Druid stage.

merc.type: Act 2 Desert Mercenary: Normal Prayer, from Nightmare (level 40) Might; alternative: Act 1 Rogue Scout (bows, amazon bows too since D2R 2.4): in Normal before Insight, or for Harmony's Vigor aura
merc.why: hireling.json: Normal Act 2 mercs have Prayer, Defiance or Blessed Aim; Might, Holy Freeze and Thorns only in Nightmare and Hell. Might raises physical damage of everyone in its radius (pets and, after the respec, the werewolf), so the same merc carries into the Fury stage.

tips: Level 1 has no skill point: melee with a club/staff; Raven from level 2.
Wear Stoutnail (stash) from level 5.
Spirit Wolves from 6, Oak Sage 1 at 7 (prerequisite only); buy a 2-socket Hard Leather Armor at Charsi if the stash's Ghost Armor (level 22) is too far.
Pick up every druid pelt: +skills to Spirit Wolf / Dire Wolf / Raven are worth wearing.
Spirit Wolf to 11 by 17 (+25% attack rating per point for the Dire Wolves and Grizzly).
Hire an Act 2 merc with Prayer (Normal: Prayer / Defiance / Blessed Aim only).
Stealth at 17 (Tal Eth), Swordback Hold and Manald Heal from 15 (both in the stash), Ancients' Pledge at 21 (Ral Ort Tal).
Keep Radament's point for Heart of Wolverine at 18; Dire Wolves at 18.

Pick up white Broad Swords / Crystal Swords that dropped with 4 sockets (Normal Act 5, the Cow Level or Nightmare: item level 26+) for Spirit (Tal Thul Ort Amn, all in the stash); the dashboard's farm list names the bases.
Keep one Izual point for the Grizzly at 30.
No reset at 40: the summoner continues.
Hire a Nightmare Act 2 Might merc (Normal mercs have no Might); give it The Battlebranch or Soul Harvest from the stash until Insight.
Grizzly to 20 first (quest points from Radament and Izual too): +10% damage per point for every pet.
Wear Jalal's Mane (42) and Raven Frost (45) as soon as found: they stay on after the Fury respec. Smoke (37, needs Lum) goes on the merc.
Farm for Raven Frost from 45: the Fury switch needs a Cannot Be Frozen item.
Spirit Wolf to 20 (Hell Den point too), then Heart of Wolverine to 20 by 75 (+153% damage, +158% attack rating for you, the merc and the pets); keep it cast instead of Oak Sage.
Hell has -100 resistances: Jalal's Mane and Ancients' Pledge give +30/+13 all, the merc's Smoke +50 all for the merc.
From 75 with the switch gear: optionally respec at Akara into Fury (see the switch note) and swap the weapon and gloves.

Staying a summoner: Ravens to 20 by 90 (their damage grows with the 60 wolf/bear base levels), then Arctic Blast 1 and Cyclone Armor with the last reserve points only (absorbs elemental damage; recast it).
Heart of the Oak (Ko Vex Pul Thul, 4-socket mace or staff) replaces the Spirit sword; Enigma (Jah Ith Ber) replaces Stealth when found.
